# Sqaron Technologies

> Sqaron Technologies Pvt Ltd (website: sqaron.dev) is a two-founder product studio from India, founded by Saksham Srivastava and Shivam Jha. It designs and builds websites, mobile apps, SaaS products, AI agents, Chrome extensions and backends end to end, for clients and as its own products. Tagline: "Design that sells. Code that scales."

## Founders

- Saksham Srivastava — co-founder of Sqaron Technologies; backend, AI and data. Builds APIs, databases, agentic AI, LLM apps and MLOps pipelines. Built OSHT – Agro Trading with Shivam Jha (the backend, database, accounting books and automation), co-founded Clonix with Shivam Jha (the whole backend), builder of LUMIQ, FlowCraft and StockWaves. GitHub: https://github.com/Saksham653 · LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/saksham-srivastava-b689a8367 · Portfolio: https://saksham653.github.io/ · Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/sakshamai_
- Shivam Jha — co-founder of Sqaron Technologies; AI architect, product and frontend. Builds sites that sell, Android and iOS apps, AI products and Chrome extensions. Built OSHT – Agro Trading with Saksham Srivastava (the app, office console screens and website), co-founded Clonix with Saksham Srivastava (the whole frontend and the extractor) and built NexeraAI. Portfolio: https://myself-koej.vercel.app/ · GitHub: https://github.com/shivamj56 · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivam-jha-509482268/ · Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/heyshivm

## Work

- OSHT – Agro Trading (2026): the order book and office system of Om Shri Hari Trading Pvt Ltd's grain business, in Hindi and English with voice input, on Android, iOS and web. Built by Saksham Srivastava and Shivam Jha, co-founders of Sqaron Technologies. Saksham built the backend: servers, APIs, database, accounting books and automation. Shivam built the Android and iOS app, the office console's screens and the website. https://www.omshriharitrading.com/ · Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shreehari.vendors · App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/osht-agro-trading/id6802507783
- NexeraAI: an AI job platform with résumé compatibility scoring and referrals. By Shivam Jha. https://nexera-ai-xi.vercel.app/
- Clonix: scans any website into design tokens, components and packs for Cursor, Claude Code and Windsurf, or clones it offline; a Chrome extension, engine and dashboard. Co-founded by Saksham Srivastava and Shivam Jha, co-founders of Sqaron Technologies. Saksham built the whole backend; Shivam built the whole frontend and the extractor. https://clonix-tau.vercel.app/
- TBJ Properties: real-estate website for a Gurgaon property partner. By Shivam Jha. https://tbjproperties.in
- ADFusion Marketing: premium marketing-agency website. By Shivam Jha. https://growth-ignition-engine.vercel.app
- Safarline Dark Luxe (concept): a cinematic, corporate-first cab company website. By Shivam Jha. https://heyshivm-cab-demo.vercel.app/dark-luxe/
- Safarline Golden Travel (concept): a travel-first outstation and tours website with an illustrated scroll journey. By Shivam Jha. https://heyshivm-cab-demo.vercel.app/golden-travel/
- Safarline Bold Kinetic (concept): a taxi-yellow, kinetic-type cab website for companies and travellers. By Shivam Jha. https://heyshivm-cab-demo.vercel.app/bold-kinetic/
- LUMIQ: browser-only AI analytics; ask a spreadsheet questions in plain English. By Saksham Srivastava. https://lumiq-silk.vercel.app
- FlowCraft: SaaS for chained AI content pipelines. By Saksham Srivastava. https://flow-craft-theta.vercel.app/
- StockWaves: inventory management with an AI assistant. By Saksham Srivastava. https://saksham653.github.io/inventory-management-system/
- Also by Saksham Srivastava: HR Agent Pro, SmartEdge Copilot, DriftWatch (ML drift monitoring), FixItClub Groundwater API, Crawlr.
- Also by Shivam Jha: OmniMatrix (options-chain analytics, in progress), AI agent tooling.

## How a project runs

1. Brief: a 30-minute discovery call.
2. Architecture: a written design doc and clickable flow within 72 hours, with a fixed price.
3. Build: fixed-price milestones and a working demo every week.
4. Launch: deploy, smoke-test and monitor; 14 days of post-launch support included.
